result.summary: A dark-themed UI screenshot showing an open approval settings dropdown above a chat/agent composer. The dropdown titled 'How should Agent actions be approved?' lists four options with icons and subtitles, with 'Manual Approval' marked selected by a green check. Below, a composer area shows partially visible placeholder text, a bottom row with a plus button, an approval mode selector labeled 'Manual Approval', an '@ Agent' selector, a model selector 'deepseek-v4.1-flash', a microphone icon, and a green send/up arrow button.
